description: The `D_LABITEMS` table provides a dictionary of laboratory items, mapping internal `ITEMID` codes to descriptive information about each lab test. This includes the test's `LABEL`, the `FLUID` sampled, the `CATEGORY` of test, and the standardized `LOINC_CODE`. The table allows for easy interpretation of lab results stored using the `ITEMID`.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: ITEMID
columns.description: Identifier for a specific lab test. Links to the D_LABITEMS table.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: The plain text label or description of the lab test associated with ITEMID.

columns.name: FLUID
columns.description: The type of fluid that was sampled for the lab test.

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.description: The broad category of the lab test performed (e.g., CHEMISTRY, BLOOD GAS).

columns.name: LOINC_CODE
columns.description: The LOINC code associated with the lab test, providing a standardized identifier.
